descriptions.w3d_d24e_skip_duplicate_c_801a7b40: Reads the last element of the owner's deque. When the target's field at +32 is zero, bit 0 of the byte at +11 is set in target and tail, both report the same key through virtual slot 5 and the tail's field at +32 is zero, returns 0; otherwise forwards self and target to 0x801a7680.
